slot.brief: Hydrolysis of a given p-block halide (e.g., SiCl4/PCl3 type) giving wrong product statements; pick correct hydrolysis outcome.

notes: from question bank ge4d49b910828 (verified in job 20261127-115414-780e)
working:
PCl$_3$ + 3 H$_2$O → H$_3$PO$_3$ + 3 HCl. The HCl gas produces dense white fumes in moist air.

Independent check: PCl₃ + 3H₂O → H₃PO₃ + 3HCl, so the products match (A).
solution:
On complete hydrolysis, phosphorus trichloride forms phosphorous acid and hydrochloric acid:
$$\mathrm{PCl_3 + 3H_2O \rightarrow H_3PO_3 + 3HCl}$$
